videos.title: Government Extends Fuel Tax Cuts Through July... Gasoline at 15%, Diesel at 25% Maintained
videos.subtitle_summary:
1. The government has extended the fuel tax cuts initially introduced to alleviate the impact of the Middle East crisis for another two months, with gasoline at 15% and diesel at 25% tax reduction maintained.
2. The government also froze the sixth round of maximum oil prices starting from 22nd at midnight, with gasoline priced at 1934 won per liter, diesel at 1923 won per liter, and heavy fuel oil at 1530 won per liter.
3. The tax reduction on fuel is intended to prevent an increase in consumer prices by reducing the tax that oil companies pay to the government when they release oil products from their factories.

videos.title: Fuel Tax Cuts Extended by 2 Months Until End of July... 15% Off Gasoline, 25% Off Diesel / YTN Sc...
videos.subtitle_summary:
1. 유류세 인하 조치가 2개월(6월 ~ 7월) 연장되었습니다. (Fuel tax cuts have been extended for 2 months, from June to end of July.)
2. 중동 전쟁 발발 이후 국민 유료비 부담을 완화하기 위해 정부는 3월 27일 2차 최고 가격 시행과 함께 유류세 인하 조치도 병행했습니다. (To alleviate the burden on citizens due to the Middle East conflict, the government implemented a second highest price and also reduced fuel tax simultaneously on March 27.)
3. 휘발료는 15%, 경유는 25%로 인하되어 있습니다. (Gasoline is reduced by 15%, diesel by 25%)

videos.title: 스타벅스 '탱크 데이' 불매운동 확산...'정용진 고발사건' 수사 / YTN
videos.subtitle_summary:
1. Starbucks 'Tank Day' event, which some claim mocks the May 18th Democratization Movement, is gaining momentum due to a social media campaign against the company. The police have launched an investigation into allegations of defamation against Starbucks Korea chairman, Jeong Yong Jin.
2. Citizen groups are criticizing Starbucks for mocking democracy and victims of the May 18th Democratization Movement through their Tank Day event, which featured tank-themed products. They are demanding a sincere apology from Jeong Yong Jin and his resignation from management.
3. Jeong Yong Jin, chairman of Starbucks Korea, has also been accused of defamation in connection with the Tank Day event and is currently under investigation by the police. The National Human Rights Commission of Korea has filed a complaint against Jeong Yong Jin and former CEO Woo Jang-hyeon for mocking the May 18th Democratization Movement and disrespecting its victims.

videos.title: '탱크 데이' 논란 불매운동 확산...'5·18 조롱' 정용진 수사 주목 / YTN
videos.subtitle_summary:
1. 스타벅스 '탱크 데이' 이벤트에서 5.18 민주화 운동을 조롱한 것으로 의심되고 있습니다.
2. SNS에는 스타벅스 불매 운동 인증이 있고, 시민 단체는 정용진 신세계 그룹 회장을 사퇴시키고 싶어하며, 국가폭력 피해 범국민 연대는 스타벅스를 규탄하고 상세한 공개를 요구했습니다.
3. 정용진 신세계 그룹 회장은 경찰에 고발이 당해, 서민 민생대책 위원회는 어제 정용진과 손정현을 모욕 명예훼손 혐의로 경찰청에 고발했습니다.

videos.title: ‘탱크데이’ 스타벅스 불매운동 확산…경찰, 정용진 수사 착수 [9시 뉴스] / KBS  2026.05.21.
videos.subtitle_summary:
1. 경찰이 직접 신세계 그룹 정용진, 스타벅스 코리아 대표 손정현전에 대한 수사를 시작하기로 했습니다. 이는 5월 18일의 '탱크데이' 행사로 고발된 신세계 그룹과 스타벅스 코리아 불매운동 때문입니다.
2. 광주 시민들은 경찰 수사를 통해 탱크데이 행사의 진실을 파악하고자 합니다. 이는 신세계 그룹이 민주원동 유적과 광주 시민의 명예를 훼손한 것으로 알려진 사건 때문입니다.
3. 불매운동에 참여하고 있는 지역 기관과 기업들은 민주주의 역사와 가치를 가볍게 여긴 기업의 상품을 사용하지 않겠다고 밝혔습니다.

videos.title: [Tesla Analysis] SpaceX has filed its S-1 l FSD 2nd Approval in Europe: Lithuania
videos.subtitle_summary:
1. SpaceX has filed its S-1 for an IPO with the anticipated ticker symbol SPCX. Major investment banks such as Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and JP Morgan are involved in the offering. If successful, SpaceX will become another large-scale listed company alongside Tesla, founded by Elon Musk.
2. SpaceX reported $186.7 billion in revenue over 25 years, but high costs, including a $101 billion investment in the first quarter alone, indicate that it is already a large company. The majority of this investment went towards AI infrastructure.
3. Starlink, a subsidiary of SpaceX, is its most profitable business. As of March 2026, it has launched over 556 tons of cargo into orbit and has 130 million subscribers in 164 countries. The first quarter revenue from Starlink was $32 billion, with an average monthly revenue per user of approximately $66. SpaceX's Starship is expected to launch on March 22, 2022, which could significantly change the cost and logistics of space travel. The AI division of SpaceX, including XAI and X, has already generated $8.18 billion in revenue in the first quarter alone, with contracts for colossal superclusters and gigawatt-class AI computer infrastructure. This suggests that SpaceX's AI division may soon be evaluated separately from its rocket and Starlink businesses. Elon Musk will continue to hold a majority voting stake in the company post-IPO, making it a company with strong founder control, similar to Tesla. However, this structure allows for long-term project execution but makes it difficult for ordinary shareholders to change the company's direction. The lockup period is also different from the standard six-month bulk release method. If the internal lockup period expires and the stock price remains 30% above the IPO price for a certain period, additional shares will be gradually released.
